messages:
Jules (Marketing): Quick: need a compact battlecard + 3 SDR hooks for the benchmark + webinar. Focus on unit-econ, migration path, and reliability. 15m?

Rae (Growth): I'm in. Test two headlines: A) 'Lower inference unit economics fast' B) 'Keep SLAs while lowering model spend'

Kai (Product): Bench soundbites: RAG: ~28% lower per-token; p95 220ms vs 320ms. Chat: ~18% lower; p95 90ms vs 140ms. Use as proof.

Liam (Sales): SDR hooks (one liners):
- "30m pilot to prove inference delta (we typically see ~28% on RAG)"
- "Quick demo: keep p95 <250ms during spikes"
- "Migration + 2-week pilot; usage credit included"

Jules (Marketing): Battlecard front draft:
- Claim: 'Cut real inference spend 20-35% vs default managed endpoints'
- How: 'runtime routing + prefix/KV caching + workload-aware batching + fallback variants'
- Proof: 'Bench: RAG ~28% cost delta; p95 220ms v 320ms'
- CTA: '30m pilot + migration support'

Rae (Growth): Inbound routing rules: message contains 'cost' -> Growth/pilot; 'latency'/'p95' -> Solutions; 'private'/'on-prem' -> AE-enterprise. Auto-reply: "Which workload (chat, RAG, embeddings)?"

bench-bot: Bench file uploaded: https://drive.redwood/bench/6812_launch_v1.pdf

Kai (Product): Rehearsal Friday 9am PT for the demo (baseline -> routing -> fallback).

Jules (Marketing): I'll produce the one-pager and 3 SDR email templates by EOD and route to legal for numeric signoff. Thanks all :rocket:
